name: otter
description: Otter.ai Enterprise Public API bridge for workspace, channel, conversation, transcript, and audio-link retrieval.

fields.name: OTTER_API_KEY
fields.label: Otter.ai API key
instructions: Otter Public API is available for Enterprise workspaces.
Open Otter, go to Integrations, then Developer, create an API key, copy it once, and paste it here.

errorHints.401: API key rejected. Create a fresh Otter Developer API key and paste it again.
errorHints.403: API key authenticated but the workspace may not have Enterprise/Public API access.
errorHints.404: Authenticated user is not in an Otter workspace, or the Public API endpoint is unavailable for this account.
errorHints.429: Otter rate limit hit. Enterprise API is currently limited to 10 requests per second.
